actionTimingBasis: Click time supplied by the capture operator; subsequent running/success states visually confirmed. State-transition timestamps are derived from the decoded source-aligned output scene-change scan, not provider completion timestamps.

checks.label: FLUJO tool round-trip
checks.response: FLUJO tool schema accepted, arguments validated, tool executed, and result received by the model.

observedResult.durationScope: Individual check durations displayed by FLUJO; do not sum them or equate them with total wall-clock time.

recoveryContext.earlierAttempt: The earlier Act 1 model test returned HTTP 401. That failure remains in the existing evidence.
recoveryContext.repair: The demo operator repaired credential configuration before this successful retry.
recoveryContext.limitations: This clip shows the successful retry. It is not evidence that the first setup attempt succeeded, and it does not expose or reproduce the private credential repair.

privacyReview.method: 25 one-second output samples, seven full-resolution source frames, and an all-frame decoded scene-change scan (500 frames, threshold 0.04).
observations: No terminal, password value, API-key value, or private filesystem path observed.
Visible provider/model IDs, base URL, test results, and timings are public/demo metadata.
No cursor is embedded in reviewed frames; no cursor was added during editing.
privacyReview.limitations: Visual sampling with an all-frame scene-change scan; not OCR or a frame-by-frame credential audit. The full 420-second source remains private and is not approved for publication.
privacyReview.publicScope: Only this 25-second output asset and this sanitized manifest are approved for public use.
